steps.code:
Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions
  secrets:   PORTAINER_URL  PORTAINER_TOKEN  PORTAINER_ENDPOINT_ID  PORTAINER_STACK_ID
  variable:  DEPLOY_ENABLED = true   (set last)

then, after each green push to main:
  Redeploy on Portainer
    Pull the new images and redeploy the stack
      Portainer accepted the redeploy.
steps.note: The job reads the stack file and environment Portainer holds and sends them back with pullImage: true, so only the images change. By hand: the stack's Pull and redeploy in Portainer. Not yet run with real credentials (ARCH-008): what you will see, not a recorded run.
While the variable is not true the job is skipped, not failed, so CI stays green before the stack exists.

steps.code:
PORTAINER_STACK_ID: secret PORTAINER_STACK_ID is required
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
steps.note: Each of the four secrets is checked first and names itself; bash prefixes the line with the script's path, left out here. Portainer is not called.

variations.title: Portainer returns an empty stack file, or refuses

steps.code:
Portainer returned an empty stack file
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.

Portainer refused the redeploy (HTTP 403): <Portainer's own message>
Error: Process completed with exit code 1.
steps.note: The two ways the call can fail after the secrets are present. Only Portainer's message is printed, never the request, which carries the stack's environment. The status code is illustrative.

variations.title: The stack file changed in the repository

steps.code:
Portainer → Stacks → endgame → Editor
  paste the new docker-compose.prod.yml
  Update the stack
steps.note: A redeploy sends back the stack file Portainer already holds, so a changed docker-compose.prod.yml must be pasted in by hand.
